name: Mazean 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Mazean is a multiplayer shooting FPS game where you command sleek robots with powerful laser guns, explosive grenades, and dynamic force fields. In this high-octane battle royale, your mission is to dismantle rival robots and seize the coveted power-up crowns to assert your dominance in the arena or die trying.
